# coolify_tag (Data Source)

Reads a Coolify team tag by UUID. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_tag" "frontend" {
  uuid = coolify_tag.frontend.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `uuid` (String) Tag UUID.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Tag name.
